rule: This independently reviewed opcode contract is canonical input. Catalog generation validates against it and never rewrites it.

runnerRequirements.handlerCoverage: one exact handlerId per definition; unknown and unhandled opcodes reject before execution
runnerRequirements.operands: one declared recursive operand shape must match exactly
runnerRequirements.bindings: produce after action success; reject forward and duplicate bindings; cross-generation use requires explicit stale probe metadata
runnerRequirements.failureProbe: probe-declared-failure runs in an isolated fixture generation, injects the named contract branch, and compares every expectedRollback leaf before discarding the isolated generation

targetReferences.pathSyntax: dot-separated operand keys; [] expands each array entry; terminal objects resolve {id} entities or {ownerId,id} components
targetReferences.resolution: Each consumed target path resolves at its action index; produced paths enter and removed paths leave the generation-local symbol table. Deliberate missing targets require fixture.params.allowedMissingTargetIds.

datasetTransitions.resolution: A successful replace transition resets the generation-local entity/component table to exactly the referenced dataset before later actions are checked. Missing optional dataset paths do not transition.

fixtureReferences.resolution: Every declared dataset and generator symbol in fixture parameters or action operands resolves against the independent fixture profile registry before generation.
